title: External payment provider outage
root_cause: An external payment provider outage can fail payments while internal dependencies remain healthy.
resolution: Propose an approved provider fallback or circuit-breaker mitigation; verify checkout and provider metrics.
pattern: checkout failures with payment provider errors and normal internal database/cache health
diagnostic: Inspect payment-service and bank API dependency health, provider errors and current code diff.
text: Synthetic V2 runbook. Compare external payment provider error rate against internal database, Redis, CPU and memory health. Provider failures without a relevant code regression support an external API outage. A coincident release alone does not justify rollback. Record external status evidence with its timestamp and source. Do not treat an old outage report as current evidence.
